content.caption: Overview of the WikiSkill framework: a three-layer agent workspace (Skill, Wiki and Raw layers) connected to a four-step evolutionary loop of inference, wiki maintenance, skill proposal, and gating with rollback.
content.description: Framework diagram in two parts. Top: three full-width grey rounded bars stacked vertically. Each bar gives a layer name with its directory, an icon, its contents and a property in parentheses. (1) Skill Layer (skills/): icon of stacked orange folders (the skill files); holds 'Evolving Procedural Knowledge'; '(Reversible, Conditional Update)'. (2) Wiki Layer (wiki/): icon of a lightbulb above a stack of books (compiled knowledge); holds 'Structured Patterns & Evolution Logs'; '(Compounding, Never Reset)'. (3) Raw Layer (raw/): padlock icon, denoting that this layer is immutable; holds 'Immutable Execution Traces'; '(Permanent, Write Once)'. Bottom: four colour-coded rounded boxes in a row. They are linked left to right by right-pointing arrows coloured like their source box (Step 1 -> Step 2 -> Step 3 -> Step 4). Step 1: Inference Agent (blue, robot-face icon): 'Execute Rollouts on the Training Set'. Step 2: Wiki Maintainer (red, gear-with-tools icon): 'Perform Root-Cause Analysis on Traces'. Step 3: Skill Proposer (yellow, lightbulb icon): 'Propose Skill Updates from Wiki and Traces'. Step 4: Gating & Rollback (green): 'Evaluate Skill Candidate on the Validation Set'. Its icon shows a box with a check mark overlapping a box with a cross, i.e. accept or reject/roll back the candidate. Vertical links run behind intermediate layers, with no arrowhead there. Step 1: a blue arrow 'Inject Skills' runs from the Skill Layer down past the Wiki and Raw layers into Step 1; there is no link between the Wiki Layer and Step 1. A blue arrow 'Write Traces' points from Step 1 up into the Raw Layer. Step 2: a red arrow 'Sample Traces' points from the Raw Layer down into Step 2. A red line 'Consolidate Patterns' rises from Step 2 past the Raw Layer, with its arrowhead at the Wiki Layer. Step 3: three yellow lines, labelled 'Read Skill, Wiki, Traces', descend from the Skill, Wiki and Raw layers respectively. All three have arrowheads pointing down into Step 3. Step 4: a green line 'Update the Skill if Better' rises from Step 4 past the Raw and Wiki layers, with its arrowhead at the Skill Layer. A green line 'Update Wiki Logs' rises from Step 4 past the Raw Layer, with its arrowhead at the Wiki Layer. A green feedback line labelled 'Next Iteration' leaves the bottom of Step 4, runs left beneath the row and points up into the bottom of Step 1, closing the loop. Net flow: the Raw Layer is written only by Step 1. The Wiki Layer receives arrows from Steps 2 and 4. The Skill Layer is updated only by Step 4. Step 3 only reads.
